name: Zcash

key_findings: No gate cap binds despite three Partial gates -- the lowest is Regulatory Clarity at 65, roughly 15 points above the raw 49.60, so the category layer alone sets the tier.

Institutions can obtain exposure but overwhelmingly transparent-only. Regulated venues have broadly moved to transparent-only support or delisted, and shielded custody remains operationally and compliance-complex, so the asset is accessible in a form that omits the feature it exists for.

Tokenomics & Supply (85) -- 21M hard cap, no premine, no VC allocation, no unlock cliffs, and a Founders' Reward that fully expired in November 2020. Held below the top band by 20% of every block subsidy still diverted to development and a lockbox of roughly 55,000-56,000 ZEC with no activated disbursement mechanism.

Security Posture is Partial on exactly one missing criterion -- the funded vulnerability bounty program closed May 26, 2026 under a flood of AI-generated submissions. Tier-1 audits, battle-testing since October 2016, and ten years without a protocol exploit all clear.

Post-quantum cryptography is live on mainnet and the Quantum gate is still Partial. ZIP 2005 shipped post-quantum commitment binding with NU6.3 Ironwood on July 28, 2026, but spend authorization, the Halo 2 proof system, and transparent ECDSA all remain vulnerable -- a quantum adversary could still take funds and merely could not mint them.

Privacy & Confidentiality (90) -- native cryptographic zero-knowledge shielding with no trusted setup from Orchard forward, a formally verified circuit as of Ironwood, viewing keys for genuine selective disclosure, and roughly 25.9% of supply shielded, up from about 21.9% a year earlier.

A 70-point internal spread between Privacy (90) and Composability & Atomicity (20). One root cause runs in both directions: a decade spent perfecting private value transfer, and no computation layer built at all.

Shielded state cannot be queried. There is no RPC that returns a shielded balance -- an agent must trial-decrypt notes with a viewing key, and must rescan from its wallet birthday to reconstruct its own position after downtime.
The Deterministic Finality FAIL cap of 54 sits roughly 12 points above the raw 42.38 and does not bind. The gate failure is not what produced the tier.

The most widely reported network incident of 2026 did not occur. Reports that no blocks were produced for over four hours on June 3 were block explorers watching an abandoned pre-fork tip after failing to upgrade across NU6.2; block production never stopped.

watch_items: NU7 coinholder vote opens August 25, 2026 against an August 24 snapshot requiring spendable Ironwood funds. Proposed scope includes 25-second block target spacing down from 75, roughly doubled shielded throughput, and explicit per-block action limits.

Full post-quantum transition is targeted for late 2027 via Project Tachyon. Only post-quantum cryptography on spend authorization and proofs moves the Quantum Resistance gate to Pass; the commitment binding already shipped does not.

EU AMLR Article 79 applies July 10, 2027, barring crypto-asset service providers, credit institutions, and financial institutions across the EU and EEA from providing services for anonymity-enhancing assets. It does not restrict holding, self-custody, or peer-to-peer transfer.
A funded bug bounty relaunch would restore the single missing Security Posture criterion and make that gate a Pass candidate.

Crosslink and the Trailing Finality Layer, a hybrid proof-of-work plus BFT finality design in prototype at Shielded Labs, would lift Deterministic Finality from Fail if activated. No confirmed mainnet date.
